title: A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 4, part 1: William Henry Harrison
summary: "A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 4, part 1" compiled by James D. Richardson is a historical collection published in 1911. This volume preserves the official proclamations, speeches, and messages of three American presidents: William Henry Harrison, John Tyler, and James K. Polk, spanning 1841 to 1849. It captures a pivotal era of American expansion and political transformation through the actual words of its leaders, offering readers direct access to the voices that shaped the nation during a critical period of growth and change.
